page_title: MNT 3-0 TOU | Montpellier v Toulouse 29/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' Christopher Jullien (Montpellier) connects well with the free kick, but heads the ball just wide of the left post from close in.
90+4' Thomas Leonard blows for a foul after Aron Donnum (Toulouse) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Montpellier have a free kick.
90+2' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) tries to catch the keeper off guard from long range, but the effort sails well wide of the right post.
90+1' Akor Adams (Montpellier) is flagged for offside.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Frank Magri (Toulouse) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Benjamin Lecomte easily catches the ball.
90' Niklas Schmidt (Toulouse) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
87' Toulouse force a corner. They send men into the box.
86' Michel Der Zakarian is forced to make a change. Maxime Esteve (Montpellier) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Christopher Jullien.
85' The game is interrupted now, Maxime Esteve (Montpellier) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
84' The substitution has been made. Kelvin Yeboah has replaced Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier).
84' The referee allows time for a substitution. Joris Chotard (Montpellier) will be replaced by Leo Leroy.
83' The ball goes out for a corner. Montpellier can continue in their attacking effort.

82' Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) blows a clear opportunity to score a goal. He was one-on-one with Guillaume Restes inside the six-yard box and attempted to put the ball low into the middle of the target, but was denied by a great save.

80' Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) wastes a promising chance! He tries his luck with a shot from mid-range, but his effort hits the left post! A few inches to the right and it could have been a sweet goal!

80' That didn't go as planned! Naatan Skytta (Toulouse) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Benjamin Lecomte, who easily kept it out.
80' Here comes a substitution. Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) is given a rest as he is replaced by Mamady Bangre.
79' Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Benjamin Lecomte has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
75' That's the end of the game for Khalil Fayad (Montpellier), who is replaced by Wahbi Khazri.
74' Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) was too forceful with his tackle and Thomas Leonard interrupted the game to signal a free kick.

72' 3 - 0 What a GOAL! A quick turnover allows Akor Adams (Montpellier) to mount a one-man counter attack and ends with him scoring with a precise shot from close in that easily beats the keeper. That makes it 3:0.
70' Carles Martinez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse) replacing Mikkel Desler.
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Cesar Gelabert Pina trots off the pitch and is replaced by Naatan Skytta (Toulouse).
70' A substitution has been made. Yanis Begraoui goes off and Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) comes on.
69' Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) tries his luck but the attempt goes well wide of the right post.
68' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Toulouse.

67' Cesar Gelabert Pina (Toulouse) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Now Toulouse have a corner.
67' Frank Magri (Toulouse) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
67' Frank Magri (Toulouse) tries his luck with and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but it is blocked by one of the defenders.
64' Niklas Schmidt (Toulouse) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
63' 2 - 0 GOAL - 2:0! The corner comes over and Kiki Kouyate flicks on with his head to Khalil Fayad (Montpellier), who makes no mistake and fires the ball into the back of the net.
63' Montpellier force their opponents to concede a corner.
60' Cesar Gelabert Pina (Toulouse) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Thomas Leonard blows his whistle for a foul.
59' Cesar Gelabert Pina (Toulouse) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Thomas Leonard blows for a foul. Montpellier have a free kick.
59' Carles Martinez has decided to make a change. Aron Donnum replaces Cristian Casseres (Toulouse).
57' Mikkel Desler (Toulouse) is knocked off balance by a defender near the penalty spot and sends his header from the corner well wide of the right post.
56' Toulouse get a corner.

55' Akor Adams (Montpellier) rises high to connect with a lofted pass inside the box, but one of his opponents is in the right place at the right time to thwart him. It will be a corner kick for Montpellier.

54' What a poor attempt! Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes yards wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Toulouse.

53' Akor Adams (Montpellier) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a decent low shot from the edge of the box towards the middle of the net, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
50' Thomas Leonard has a clear sight and sees a foul from Yanis Begraoui (Toulouse). A free kick has been awarded to Montpellier.

48' Maxime Esteve (Montpellier) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is so wild it sails way past the right post and behind for a goal kick. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Toulouse.
47' Rasmus Nicolaisen (Toulouse) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. Montpellier will take a free kick.
46' The whistle blows and Thomas Leonard starts the second half.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Kiki Kouyate (Montpellier) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Thomas Leonard had an easy-decision to make.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
44' A player from Montpellier commits a rough challenge. Thomas Leonard blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Toulouse get a free kick.

40' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Niklas Schmidt (Toulouse) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Montpellier will have a goal kick.
40' Mikkel Desler (Toulouse) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.

39' Joris Chotard (Montpellier) tries to hit a shot towards goal from long range, but he miskicks the ball and it flies high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Toulouse will have a goal kick.
39' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Montpellier, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
38' Thomas Leonard shows a yellow card to Frank Magri (Toulouse) for his blatant foul.
36' Montpellier take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
35' Falaye Sacko (Montpellier) unleashed a powerful long-range strike, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way. The referee blows his whistle, Montpellier are awarded a corner kick.
34' The ball falls kindly for Khalil Fayad (Montpellier) inside the box, but it's a poor effort and flies well wide of the left post.
34' The referee can't ignore those comments and Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) sees a yellow card for bad language.
30' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Montpellier, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
30' Khalil Fayad (Montpellier) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
30' Yanis Begraoui (Toulouse) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Benjamin Lecomte easily deals with the threat.
26' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. That's a free kick to Montpellier.
23' Thomas Leonard couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Akor Adams (Montpellier) and blew his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Toulouse.
19' One of the Toulouse players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul. A free kick to Montpellier.

17' Rasmus Nicolaisen (Toulouse) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the middle of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
17' Niklas Schmidt (Toulouse) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

13' 1 - 0 Teji Savanier sends a lovely ball into Akor Adams (Montpellier). He latches on to it and shoots into the bottom left corner from the edge of the box. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 1:0.
11' Frank Magri (Toulouse) gets himself into a promising goalscoring position, but he blazes the ball high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Montpellier.
10' Logan Costa (Toulouse) is caught offside!
9' Thomas Leonard interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Khalil Fayad (Montpellier). Toulouse are awarded the free kick.
7' Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
6' Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
4' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) has a go from distance but he can't find the target as it goes well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Toulouse will have a goal kick.
3' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the bottom left corner, but Guillaume Restes was alert and made a comfortable save.
1' Referee Thomas Leonard sees the trip by Maxime Esteve (Montpellier) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Toulouse are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Montpellier will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Thomas Leonard.
